questions.question: What is the total revenue by customer state?
questions.sql:
SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
       round(sum(p.payment_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
questions.note: I used payment value as revenue, since this breakdown is by customer state rather than by product, category or seller. Canceled and unavailable orders are excluded.

questions.question: Which 5 product categories had the largest drop in revenue from July 2018 to August 2018?
questions.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT coalesce(p.product_category_name_english, 'unknown') AS category,
         sum(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
                   AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'
                  THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS jul_rev,
         sum(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01'
                   AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
                  THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS aug_rev
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT category,
       round(jul_rev, 2) AS revenue_jul_2018,
       round(aug_rev, 2) AS revenue_aug_2018,
       round(aug_rev - jul_rev, 2) AS revenue_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY aug_rev - jul_rev ASC
LIMIT 5
questions.note: Assumptions: revenue by category is item sales (SUM of `price`, excluding freight) with canceled and unavailable orders excluded; the drop is August minus July, so the largest drops are the most negative changes; categories with no August sales count as zero.
